title: Benedict Gross and Epstein proposal for evolutionary dynamics at Harvard

tellings.quote: and Harvard references an imaginative proposal by Benedict Gross and Jeffrey Epstein.

plain: In the 2000s, Harvard is said to have set up its work on evolutionary dynamics, linked to the scientist Martin Nowak, out of a proposal from Benedict Gross and Jeffrey Epstein. The researcher Eric Weinstein brings it up with Michels, pointing to a Harvard text that, as he quotes it, 'references an imaginative proposal by Benedict Gross and Jeffrey Epstein.' Those words credit Epstein as co-author of the proposal. What the proposal led to, and how far Epstein shaped the work, the quoted line does not say.
